# PDF to JPG / PNG

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/pdf-to-images/

Render selected pages of a PDF into JPEG or PNG images locally, with adjustable resolution and a ZIP export for several pages.

## How to use it

1. Choose the PDF documents or images from your device.
2. Arrange files or enter the pages and layout options.
3. Create the document and download the finished PDF.

## Example

Export pages 1–3 as JPEG at 150 DPI for a document preview.

## Limits and checks

Raster images contain pixels rather than selectable PDF text. Rendering large pages uses memory; select a small page range and keep the original PDF.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
